The front end of the body is a socket-shaped mouth: a round, ringed, hollow opening set in a thick rim of pale flesh, open and empty, the most prominent feature of the front view. Rear view, seen from behind: the segmented back and tapered tail end of the grub fill the view, the head and mouth hidden on the far side of the body, and the back shows only rings and soft skin. Soft top lighting, muted pale palette, small creature, simple readable silhouette that stays clear at small size.
